stemMd: A line passes through (2,3) and (6,11). What is its slope?
explanationMd: Slope equals change in y divided by change in x: (11−3)/(6−2)=8/4=2.

distractorRationale.b: This does not use the difference of the y-coordinates.
distractorRationale.e: This is the vertical change alone.
distractorRationale.d: This is the horizontal change alone.
distractorRationale.a: This divides horizontal change by vertical change.
